label: agentdb • page a result set with limit/offset
query: Your agent database already has a table named numbers with columns n (INTEGER) and token (TEXT) holding 25 rows in ascending n order. Without loading the whole table at once, use db_query's limit and offset to page through it in ascending order and tell me the token value in the 23rd row.
notes: WS4 proof: exercises db_query limit/offset paging with a non-guessable answer token (not equal to the row number). seedSql stages the rows before the run. toolUsageAudit pins offset usage; dbState pins table integrity.
